limitations: Docker daemon unavailable. VHDX includes all Docker projects, layer caches and unused space; it is not project image size. The measured development snapshot includes historical caches, two ZIP copies and a host GPU Python environment; not a fresh CPU installation minimum or peak build requirement. Hard-linked venv/cache files counted once. No Docker-inclusive minimum is estimated. Models within repo caches/image must not be counted again. Missing home HuggingFace/Torch cache directories are not assumed model-free; models also live inside pipeline caches.
